title: Yellow Fluffy Moroccan Avocado Chebakia
description: A light and fluffy Moroccan dish featuring avocado hass pulp, cured in a mixture of spices and herbs, and cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This macrobiotic friendly dish is a twist on traditional chebakia.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, coconut sugar, and sea salt.
Add the orange blossom water, rose water, ground cinnamon, and ground ginger to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Fold in the avocado hass pulp until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable and easy to shape.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a chebakia.
Place the chebakia in the preheated tandoor clay pot and cook for 15 minutes.
Flip the chebakia over and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the chebakia from the tandoor clay pot and let cool for 5 minutes.
